verdict.rationale: The Windows marketing page promotes Copilot for getting work done, but only inside Microsoft apps like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint (windows-docs-7). The support docs mention built-in AI features such as Paint Cocreator and vague 'AI tools on Windows', which shows some first-party AI assistance bundled with Windows. The Windows AI APIs and AI Foundry toolkit are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of an OS-level assistant that accepts and carries out delegated tasks across Windows, details of what tasks it can perform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
